integrity.method: Exact arithmetic in Z[phi] and exhaustive enumeration of all 64 sign selections.

scientific_limitations: The claim is restricted to the standard regular icosahedron coordinate model with edge length 2.
It does not classify antipodal polytopes for arbitrary point sets or settle the general thick-polytope question.
Independent audit has not been performed.
title: Exact volume spectrum of antipodal vertex selections in the regular icosahedron
